text: {"assertions":["A conflict loop was discovered in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift on 2026-03-01 that only manifested after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The conflict loop could be reproduced by editing the same note on two devices while offline.","The root cause of the conflict loop was schema drift between the migration and the model.","The symptom of the conflict loop was two clients rewriting each other on every sync pass.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning the checksum, implemented in PR #2260 on branch fix/conflict-loop-1.","The fix improved p99 latency from 1.7 seconds to 127 milliseconds.","This conflict loop issue occurred in the same area of SyncEngine.swift as earlier conflict loop work, allowing context to carry over."]}
